usedFor: Airtable holds the contact rows; ApexVerify checks whether an email address or phone number is real. A changed record can go through “Verify Email or Phone”, or be uploaded with “Create Verification Batch”.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Verify Email or Phone” in ApexVerify
bestTemplate.why: Each new or edited row gets its email or phone checked on the spot, and you choose the verification type and target country.

watchOut: “Record Created Or Updated” polls and also fires on edits, so a row can be verified again after any change. “Verify Email or Phone” needs a verification type and country chosen.
